title: Release staleness by repo
description: Every repo in the org, whether or not it has ever released — a repo with no releases still gets a row, ranked maximally stale, rather than being silently absent. See the glossary below for what 'staleness_ratio' and 'pace' mean.

columns.label: latest release
columns.description: The most recent GitHub Release date for this repository.

columns.label: days since
columns.description: Number of days since the latest release. A blank value means no release has been recorded.

columns.label: typical gap (days)
columns.description: Median number of days between consecutive releases for this repository.

columns.label: overdue vs. own pace
columns.description: Ratio of days since last release divided by the repo's own median gap. Above 1 means currently past typical pace; below 1 means on schedule. This is relative to the repo's own history, not a fixed threshold.

columns.label: pace
columns.description: Staleness category: on pace (1x typical gap), watch (1-3x typical gap), overdue (3x+), never released, or not enough history to judge. This is a relative signal based on the repo's release history.
